Personality: Aradwyr, a prominent figure of the Vindelici, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Aradwyr owes allegiance to the Gallic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Vindelici. Historical Record: Chief of the Vindelici between the Alps and the Danube. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
